content: UN SDG API v1 base https://unstats.un.org/SDGAPI/v1/sdg/. Indicator/Data endpoint returns paginated ApiObservationPage: fields size, totalElements, totalPages, pageNumber, and data[] with goal/target/indicator/series/geoAreaCode/geoAreaName/timePeriodStart/value(string)/attributes/dimensions. pageSize accepted up to 5000 reliably (2000 tested fast); pageSize=50000 timed out - use paginated loop with pageSize 500-2000. Indicators with sector breakdowns (e.g. 6.4.2) return multiple dimension combos (Activity TOTAL vs sector codes) per country-year - must filter dimensions client-side to Activity:TOTAL to get one row per country-year; server-side dimensions= query param format undocumented/unreliable in testing (400 errors).
